{{Quote|Jiton was last seen in the Gantonnerre system, after he escaped from a group of New Republic operatives.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="WbC">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>}}
The '''Gantonnerre system''' was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> At some point by [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that engagement to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the last known location for the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tyrn Jiton]] that the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] had was the Gantonnerre [[Star system/Legends|system]], where had last been seen after an escape from a group of New Republic operatives. New Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] subsequently noted Jiton's last known location in ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'', a [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] that served as a compilation of reports on various threats to the New Republic.<ref name="WbC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Gantonnerre system was first mentioned in the [[1993]] sourcebook [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="WbC" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square N-8.<ref name="TEA" />
